title_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会在京隆重举行 习近平出席并发表重要讲话
title_en: Commemoration of Jiang Zemin's Centenary Held in Beijing; Xi Jinping Attends and Delivers Speech
summary_zh: 纪念江泽民同志诞辰100周年大会17日上午在北京隆重举行，中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平出席大会并发表重要讲话。
summary_en: A grand ceremony marking the centenary of Jiang Zemin's birth was held in Beijing on the morning of August 17. Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, Chinese President, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, attended and delivered an important speech.
